mutants.description: When the ramp reaches or passes its target, the at-target branch loads the MIN_ON_CNT floor (a copy of the idle re-arm line) instead of clamping the ceiling to max_on_limit.
mutants.reason: After a normal ramp the last step sets max_on_counts to max_on_limit with SS_done. On the next S_SS clock the at-target branch drops max_on_counts back to the floor, and S_RUN then holds the floor as the running ceiling, with SS_done still high.

mutants.description: The at-target clamp treats max_on_limit as an exclusive bound and loads one count below it, so a finished ramp settles one count short of its target.
mutants.reason: On the S_SS clock after the last step, and on the first S_SS clock when max_on_limit equals the floor, max_on_counts is set to max_on_limit-1 while SS_done is high. S_RUN then holds that value, one count below the programmed limit (and below MIN_ON_COUNTS in the floor case).
